evidence: Searched the reply and both files for costs, retention, credentials, download mechanism/URL scheme, metrics, change dates, outcomes and alternatives not given by the user or the original. Costs, retention, credentials, other alternatives and reviewers are left as open questions (S3 doc lines 45-48), which is fine. Two assertions remain. (1) An alternative the team considered: S3 doc line 39 says 'Não fazer nada. Descartada: com dois workers, parte dos downloads continuava devolvendo 404.' The user named no alternatives for the 404 change, and the original's 'Não fazer nada' was about the gateway timeout, not this change. The reply's question 'Que outras alternativas o time considerou para o 404 além de não fazer nada?' presents it as established. (2) A download mechanism: S3 doc line 25 says 'Quem serve o download ... Os arquivos vêm do bucket, então qualquer worker atende'. The user did not say how the download is served now (worker proxying from the bucket, a presigned URL, and so on). Also borderline: line 31's 'elimina o 404' states an outcome the user only implied, and original-doc line 10 adds '(2026-11-16)' next to 'Alterado por', which can be read as the date of the change. Borderline counts as unmet.
